subject: reasoning
question: Manyak travels 20 km westwards and then turns left and travels 12 km. He then turns left again and travels 55 km. How far is Manyak now from the starting point?
solution:
According to the statement

Manyak travels 20 km westwards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/129fa13634057ca475938d06ab095d00cd016bb570135700caebe621069a2521.png] 

After that turn left and travel 12 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8123bf8ce3e9ab8df9d71a8920af60cf717cefa1f3e1124d40eb50248974d05a.png] 

Again turn left and travel 55 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a0ee4ec01900a2d1017769817a952e92336aada66ff3d210f31874fc25cfa0a.png] 

Manyak is from the starting point is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5681d579d3abcce64c6d7febe886936e7524a5027687519330add98c7ee39813.png] 

Applying Pythagoras;

Distance² = 12² + 35²

Distance2 = 144 + 1225

Distance² = 1369

Distance = 37

Hence, the correct answer is **"37".**
